versions.subject: feat: add new rules related to cloudflared usage (#4243)
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' tunnel '
        - ' run '
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' --config '
        - ' --credentials-contents '
        - ' --credentials-file '
        - ' --token '
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine="* tunnel *" CommandLine="* run *" CommandLine IN ("* --config *", "* --credentials-contents *", "* --credentials-file *", "* --token *")
